title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to quickly check whether the table is a system table in AL
summary: System tables in Business Central have IDs in the range 2,000,000,000 and above and cannot be extended. The post explains how to check if a table is a system table using the IsSystemTable procedure from the Config. Management codeunit, which is the standard method used in the Configuration Package feature.
key_points: System tables have IDs of 2,000,000,000 and above and cannot be extended
The standard method to check if a table is a system table is the IsSystemTable procedure
This procedure is found in codeunit 8616 'Config. Management'
Configuration Package feature uses this control when system tables are added

quotes.text: System and virtual tables can't be extended. System tables are created in the ID range of 2.000.000.000 and above.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the core characteristic and ID range of system tables that developers must understand
Provides the standard built-in method for checking whether a table is a system table
